claim: @byokit/openclaw 0.29.0 is prepared for consumer installation: the packed tarball installs into a fresh app, imports, and pins engine openclaw 2026.11.1, and the kit on that real pinned engine streams input_delta tool-input progress during a file-writing tool call driven by a deterministic Claude CLI stand-in. Nothing is published yet, and no real account or model was used.

steps.start: A fresh app home with no account, on the pinned engine the kit installs from the patched set
steps: The kit starts the real pinned engine with a stand-in Claude Code login
The app lists Claude Code models and sees claude-cli ids available
The app runs Claude Code on a file-writing tool call and sees live tool input progress as input_delta events
The app keeps the memory tools, learning off and auto, and lease contention working on the new pin
steps.result: PASS: a Claude Code account lists claude-cli models, runs in its own folder, and a file-writing tool call streamed input_delta progress

steps.start: The release branch with the version bump; nothing published
steps: Install the tarball into a fresh consumer app with an empty HOME
Read the installed version and engine pin
steps.result: A fresh app that installs the tarball gets @byokit/openclaw 0.29.0 pinned to engine 2026.11.1, and it imports.

verdicts.seen: Read 3 PASS lines. Gates pass; the kit started the real pinned engine 2026.11.1; a Claude Code account lists claude-cli models, runs in its own folder, and a file-writing tool call streamed input_delta progress. This matches the outcome's engine and streaming claims, with no errors.
